method: User controls only; read-only IndexedDB evidence; no state injection.

results.name: 01-fixture-history
results.detail: Create/reschedule/cancel preserve one identity and old played date; cancelled status survives reload.

results.name: 02-training-evidence
results.detail: RSVP does not check in; held expected session contributes 1/1, cancelled occurrence excluded independently.

results.name: 03-snapshots-and-formats
results.detail: Prepared profiles are unchanged after edit; 5- and 11-place formations save with distinct stable slots.

results.name: 04-historical-results
results.detail: A friendly win adds 3 points; corrected loss removes them with before/after audit; unknown participation remains null.

results.name: 05-private-role-projections
results.detail: Player sees own named rows only; responses leave attendance unknown; spectator has no private report/control or withheld derived score.

results.name: 06-exact-photo-revision
results.detail: Pending media stays private; exact approval publishes v1/v2, previous approved revision remains until replacement approval, removal blocks spectator retrieval.

results.name: 07-private-ballot
results.detail: No default +59 cutoff; explicit fictional +25; self excluded, one player changes own private revision, manager sees no ballot, latest valid vote seals under original deadline.

results.name: 08-invitations-revocation
results.detail: Individual invitation and season grant revocations retain audit and block old spectator gallery retrieval.

results.name: 09-durability-stale-tab
results.detail: Reload preserves accepted team document; stale second-tab write cannot overwrite it and retained rejected projection survives reload.

limitations: Fictional local role controls do not establish server authorisation.
Native encryption, background delivery, reboot and lock need physical iPhone/Android verification.
Photo processing uses original synthetic illustrations; device picker/upload/scanning are not proved.
